name: Chenango County, NY
findings: Chenango County has 338 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Chenango County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Chenango County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
